lines.say: Five facts about lightning. One: it hits Earth about 44 times every second.
lines.caption: 44 per second

lines.say: Two: a bolt is about 50,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Five times hotter than the Sun's surface.
lines.caption: Hotter than the Sun

lines.say: Three: thunder is the air around the bolt exploding from that heat.
lines.caption: Thunder

lines.say: Four: it does strike twice. The Empire State Building is hit about 20 times a year.
lines.caption: Strikes twice

lines.say: Five: count the seconds to the thunder, divide by three. That's the distance in kilometers.
lines.caption: Count it
